marks.q: In light of our most recent results, we are on track to post record revenues of around EGP 4.9 billion in FY 2021, representing a year-on-year growth above the 80% mark, with a normalised EBITDA margin9 in the 50% range.

In Egypt and Jordan, we are aiming to capitalise on our market leading position, expanded product offering and patient base, increased service delivery capabilities, and growing visibility to continue delivering robust growth in the year ahead.
In light of this, we are revising our full-year guidance, with the Company now on track to deliver conventional revenue year-on-year growth of at least 18% to 20%.

In light of the aforementioned and our robust performance in the first half of the year, we are maintaining our full-year guidance, with the Company on track to record conventional revenue year-on-year growth of around 20%.

With all this in mind, despite the current macroeconomic challenges, we continue to target double-digit full-year conventional revenue growth, largely in line with our full-year guidance prior to recent macro developments.

In light of the above and the results recorded in the first three months of the year, we are confident that despite the ongoing economic challenges witnessed in our geographies, we have put in place the necessary strategies and mitigation mechanisms to continue delivering double-digit conventional revenue growth in 2023.

Considering our strong first half results, the solid strategies in place, and the positive momentum enjoyed by our Egyptian and Jordian subsidiaries, we reaffirm our guidance of full-year conventional revenue (excluding Covid-19-related contributions) year-on-year growth of around 30% for FY 2023.

In light of the continued strengths of our results, the solid strategies in place, and the positive momentum enjoyed by our operations in Egypt and Jordan, we reaffirm our guidance of 30% conventional revenue growth, boosting our consolidated revenues to the EGP 4 billion mark, with a normalised EBITDA margin excluding one-off expenses and pre-operating expenses in Saudi Arabia of 28-30% for FY 2023.
Throughout these markets, we will continue to target double-digit revenue growth supported by a combination of higher volumes and prices.

In light of the strong results posted during the first quarter of the year, the economic recovery we are witnessing in our home market, and the positive policies set forth by the Egyptian government and central bank, we reaffirm our guidance of approximately 30% revenue growth in FY 2024.

As such, we are reaffirming our guidance of approximately 30% revenue growth in FY 2024, with an expected EBITDA margin of around 30% for the year, excluding non-recurring expenses and results from our newly inaugurated venture in Saudi Arabia.

In light of our strong start to the year and the improving operating conditions, we see revenue growth for the year coming in above 30% in FY 2025.

marks.q: In light of our strong first half performance and the steadily improving operating conditions across our markets, we see full-year revenue growth coming in above 30% in FY 2025.
We expect the full-year to close on a strong note, with continued revenue growth and robust margins supported by our scalable platform, best-in-class service quality, and our high-calibre team.

With an experienced management team, a clear strategic direction, improving macroeconomic conditions, and a renewed focus on value creation, we are confident in our ability to deliver sustainable growth in the years ahead.

While management continues to closely monitor evolving regional developments and macroeconomic conditions, we believe IDH remains well positioned to build on its momentum and continue delivering sustainable long-term growth.
